description: Runtime finalization helper: folds a session's append-only provenance.jsonl trail into a single conformant kind:'provenance' document (PROV-aligned: agents, activities, entities), embeddable in BIDS-Derivatives and RO-Crate.

provenance_log.description: The session provenance.jsonl trail. Resolved from $NEUROFLOW_SESSION when omitted.

run_record.description: Conformant NeuroFlow provenance document for the run.

block.label: Fold Run Provenance
block.description: Emit a PROV-aligned provenance document from the run trail.

neuroflow/launch.description: Reads $NEUROFLOW_SESSION/provenance.jsonl and writes $NEUROFLOW_OUTPUT_DIR/run.provenance.json. Optional env: NEUROFLOW_RUN_ID, NEUROFLOW_RUN_STATUS, NEUROFLOW_WORKFLOW_ID, NEUROFLOW_WORKFLOW_VERSION.
